story_text: Yesterday, I wanted to build a house in Minecraft for my dog Niuniu. I did not have any ideas, so I borrowed an idea from my friend Tom's world. First, I built a small red house with a soft bed inside. After that, I added a blue door and a garden with yellow flowers. My dog Niuniu sat next to me and watched the screen. I wanted to add a swimming pool too, but my mom said it was time for dinner. I felt a little disappointed because I was not completely finished. Instead, I saved my game and told Niuniu about my plan. "Tonight we will finish the pool," I said. Niuniu barked happily, like she understood every word.

vocabulary.example: I did not have any ideas, so I borrowed an idea from my friend Tom's world.
I felt a little disappointed because I was not completely finished.
Instead, I saved my game and told Niuniu about my plan.

comprehension_questions: What did the boy want to build in Minecraft for Niuniu?
Why do you think Niuniu barked happily at the end, even though dogs cannot understand English words?
speaking_questions: Have you ever borrowed an idea from a friend? What was it?
If you could build a house for Niuniu in Minecraft, what would you put inside it?
Tell me about a time you felt disappointed. What happened?

writing_task.prompt: Write about a time you built or made something, in a game or in real life. Use the sentence starters below to write three sentences about it in the past tense.
scaffold: First, I ___ (what you built or made).

parent_observation: 朗读时能否流畅读出过去时动词（wanted, borrowed, built, felt）而不卡顿。
复述故事时能否用完整句子按顺序说出"发生了什么→接下来发生了什么"。
写作三句话是否主动使用了过去时和连接词（after that/because），而不是习惯性用现在时。
提到Minecraft和niuniu时是否表现出兴趣，主动补充自己的真实经历。
